title: Installed numerical-engine acceptance
question: Does the packaged RK4 engine integrate dx/dt = 1 from x(0) = 0?
scientific_boundary: A deterministic software acceptance fixture, not an empirical scientific claim.
hypothesis: At t = 1 the computed state is x = 1 within 1e-8.
limitations: No external models, credentials or network research. This checks the offline numerical engine; PhaseForge does not bundle a local LLM.
